stemMd: An axonometric drawing uses screen vectors u = (2,1), v = (−2,1), w = (0,3) for one unit along x, y, z. Where is the spatial point (2,1,1) drawn relative to the origin?
explanationMd: The image is 2u + v + w = (4,2) + (−2,1) + (0,3) = (2,6). Parallel projection is linear, so each coordinate weights its corresponding screen vector.

distractorRationale.d: This uses the wrong sign for the y-axis screen direction.
distractorRationale.b: This omits the projected height contribution.
distractorRationale.c: This omits the negative horizontal contribution of v.
distractorRationale.a: This combines the coordinate weights incorrectly.
